mapper.select: SELECT project_id, workspace_id, objective, problem, success_metrics, constraints, owner, deadline, updated_by, created_at, updated_at FROM project_plans WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND project_id = #{projectId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_plans (project_id, workspace_id, objective, problem, success_metrics, constraints, owner, deadline, updated_by) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{workspaceId}, #{objective}, #{problem}, #{successMetrics}, #{constraints}, #{owner}, #{deadline}, #{updatedBy}) ON CONFLICT (project_id) DO UPDATE SET workspace_id = EXCLUDED.workspace_id, objective = EXCLUDED.objective, problem = EXCLUDED.problem, success_metrics = EXCLUDED.success_metrics, constraints = EXCLUDED.constraints, owner = EXCLUDED.owner, deadline = EXCLUDED.deadline, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
